title: ES Opening Pivot–Cloud Rejection/Support
summary: Frozen retrospective ES pivot/cloud comparison across 754 eligible sessions. Early and confirmed primary entries lost after costs; 81 of 82 paired fills coincided, and optional filters reduced participation without a profitable 2R variant.
data_summary: Independent annual Verne releases 2022–2026; observed/eligible span 2022-05-16 through 2026-09-18, 754 sessions. All historical available_at values remain null; strict quoted-contract matching and 250-bar published readiness.
evidence_status: Sealed corrected reproduction of the initial frozen protocol; all 20 numerical files byte-identical. 83 fresh synthetic tests, independent reconstruction of 12,064 baseline and 9,048 sensitivity outcomes, statistics and publication projections. Primary early/confirmed net per eligible session −$20.46/−$16.56; superiority inconclusive. Historical pre-open availability and native TradingView parity unverified. Local preview only.
